_meta.description: Crosstab count of region x segment decorated with TWO overlay layers — OVERLAY_CHISQ_ROW and OVERLAY_CHISQ_COL — that each compute a per-axis chi-square goodness-of-fit statistic against the matching margin. CHISQ_ROW asks 'do the column counts within each row diverge from the row-margin proportions?'; CHISQ_COL asks 'do the row counts within each column diverge from the column-margin proportions?'. Both fold the same expected-vs-observed recurrence as the whole-table OVERLAY_CHISQ_MATRIX (03_crosstab_chisq_matrix.json) but emit per-row / per-column statistics instead of a single scalar — the per-axis surface is the canonical drill-down shape for finding which rows / columns drive the table-level divergence. Implicit-margin contract — Ref must be empty (the host's row / column margins are the canonical expected slot).
_meta.name: crosstab-chisq-row-and-col
